## Install

| System | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `inkboard_*_x64-setup.exe` (per-user install, no administrator rights) or `inkboard_*_x64_en-US.msi` |
| **macOS** | `Inkboard_*_aarch64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) or `Inkboard_*_x64.dmg` (Intel) |
| **Linux** | `inkboard_*_amd64.deb` or `inkboard_*_x86_64.AppImage` |

Windows users can also run `winget install Inkboard.Inkboard` once the package is published (see the README).

Check your download against the `SHA256SUMS-*.txt` files attached below. Installers that are not code-signed make Windows SmartScreen show
"Windows protected your PC": choose *More info* → *Run anyway*; on macOS, Control-click the app → *Open*.
